frozen_oa_course_units.checked_theorem: For x>=2 and T>0, the half-weighted psi formula is truncated at |Im rho|<T with the stated distance-to-prime-power remainder.

frozen_oa_course_units.checked_proof: Every zero rho is counted with multiplicity; the proof reaches 'We are done!'.

transfer.endpoint: u=ceil(x)-1, v=floor(x+y); half-weight transfer and v-u=y+O(1) cost O(log x).
transfer.remainder: At integral u,v the distance to every other prime power is at least 1; for 2<=T<=x, two endpoint remainders are O(x(log x)^3/T).
transfer.height_convention: The |gamma|<T to literal |rho|<=T mismatch is in unit boundary strips and costs O(x log T/T), using the HSW+Bui multiplicity-inclusive local count.
